title: A list view bound to an object outside the writing package's dependency closure skips the field-reference check: unknown `columns` fields are accepted (200 active, draft → publish) where the same body is refused 422 `list-view-field-unknown`
body:
Filing gate: ① — product defect against a declared contract, with a reproduction (QA-measured).

Path: none (no checklist clause asserts this; observed while driving platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip, priority P1 — tri-state ③, "no item asserts the capability")
Type: Bug (prefilled — violates the declared runtime-door contract of `validateListViewFieldRefs` and of the package-closure gate, quoted below)
QA-source: #24557 · platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip · observation outside the clauses (verified by an independent re-run)

reach: measured once through the public HTTP door — `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qavfy_r1?package=com.qa.vfy2` with a `columns` entry naming a field that does not exist answers **200 `state:"active"`** with no advisory at framework 5b14b7f3; the identical body sent as an overlay answers 422 `list-view-field-unknown`. The served view then breaks: the console shows "This view's query was rejected" (`GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?fields=title,zzz_nope` → 400 `INVALID_FIELD`).

## What happens

A list view written into a writable package is checked for unknown field references **only if its bound object is inside the package's dependency closure**. When the view binds an object the package does not declare a dependency on (e.g. a code-package object such as `showcase_task`), or an object that does not exist at all, both the active PUT and draft → `publish-drafts` accept unknown `columns` fields silently (`probes.issues: []`, `_diagnostics.valid: true`). The same body is refused `422 list-view-field-unknown` as an overlay, from a package that declares the dependency, or when bound to the package's own object.

## Reproduction (showcase, admin)

1. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.vfy2","name":"QA Vfy2","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qavfy2"}}` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qavfy_r1?package=com.qa.vfy2` body `{"name":"showcase_task.qavfy_r1","object":"showcase_task","viewKind":"list","label":"r1","type":"grid","data":{"provider":"object","object":"showcase_task"},"columns":[{"field":"title"},{"field":"zzz_nope"}]}`
   - expected: 422 `list-view-field-unknown` at `views[0].columns[1].field`
   - actual: 200 `state:"active"`, no advisories.
3. Draft path: same body with `?mode=draft&package=com.qa.vfy2`, then `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.vfy2/publish-drafts {}` → `outcome:"published"`, `probes.issues: []`.
4. Controls (all refused 422 `list-view-field-unknown`): the same body with no `?package` (overlay); from a package declaring `dependencies:{"com.example.showcase":"*"}`; a view bound to an object the package itself owns. Binding `nosuch_obj` also answers 200.

## Mechanism

1. `resolveWritePackageScope` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) feeds `narrowObjectsToPackageClosure` (`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`), which removes `showcase_task` from `stack.objects` — its owner is neither the writing package, a declared dependency, nor a system object.
2. `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`: `if (!graph.has(object) || !graph.get(object)) return;` skips the whole view, deferring an unresolvable base object to `validateObjectReferences`.
3. `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`: `validateObjectReferences` runs on `runtimeTypes: ['flow','dataset']` only — never on `view` writes — so the deferred finding never fires. Neither an error nor an advisory reaches the author.

## Declared contract it violates

- `reference-integrity-suite.ts` notes on `validateListViewFieldRefs` (`runtimeTypes: ['flow','view','object']`): the standalone list view "a Studio tenant or an MCP/AI author writes goes through that door … a build-time-only rule would never reach the author who made the typo", and "no missing-collection false-positive channel".
- The `RuntimePackageScope` doc in `runtime-gate.ts`: "the failure direction is more validation input, never less" and "⛔ There is deliberately no branch that narrows on a guess and no branch that skips rules" — here the narrowing makes the rule skip.
- `runtime-gate.package-closure.test.ts` pins "DOES judge a reference outside the declared dependencies" — flows do report this case (`flow-trigger-unknown-object`); views report nothing.

Related, closed: #14107 made list-view field references checked at author time in `os validate` / `os build`; this is the runtime door's out-of-closure gap.

## Filing-gate answers

- Category: ① (finding class (b): violates a declared contract; reach measured above).
- Acting reader: the lane owning `packages/lint` runtime gate + `packages/metadata-protocol` write scope — candidate fixes: dispatch an object-reference check for `views[].data.object` on `view` writes, or resolve the field check against the full object collection when the bound object is outside the closure, or refuse/warn on the out-of-closure binding itself.
- Duplicate search (open AND closed), objectstack: "list-view-field-unknown view columns unknown field accepted on draft publish writable package" → 10 hits (#24253, #23715, #14107, #10377, #8908, #8858, #8595, #8594 among them — none this defect; #14107 is the build-time sibling).
